title: IntentGate committed intent acceptance
description: `acceptance.json` in the out dir of the PR check, schema intentgate.acceptance/1, written by `intentgate acceptance` (pr-check.md §7, REQ-0045). For each lock of the pull request whose root intent is a committed intent: was that intent accepted, that is, did it reach the base branch through a pull request approved by a code owner? A report only: it never changes verify.json, the exit code or the conclusion. Intents are sorted by lock_id, and every key is always present.

intents.description: One entry per lock with source committed-intent that validates; empty when there is none.

blob.description: The git blob id the lock records for it.

status.description: accepted: an approver of the merged pull request is a code owner of the file. not-accepted: this version is not on the base branch, it reached it without a pull request, or its approvers are none of its code owners. unknown: it cannot be decided (no code owner, owned by a team or an email, or the API could not be read).

pr.description: The merged pull request that brought the intent to the base branch; 0 when there is none or it is not known.
